name: Knott's Johnny Rockets (Boardwalk) Plain Single Cheddar Burger, Grilled Chicken or Sourdough Melt
brandOrRestaurant: Johnny Rockets (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Freshly griddled single burger patty or grilled chicken breast on a soft bun or sourdough bread with American/cheddar cheese and thick-cut potato fries.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Original Single Burger or Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich plain with cheese only (no grilled onions, relish, lettuce, tomato, or spicy Houston jalapeños).
watchOuts: Avoid the spicy Houston Burger (jalapeños) and Smoke House fried onion rings
